description: The three RED-MACHINE-1 messages with 12 letters each in the first two replaced by dits (seeded, positions reproducible), written with different dit characters: '.' for the first, '-' for the second, none for the third. Guards the whole dit pipeline end to end: reading each message by its own dit character, a window containing a dit never matching, true positions, and the dit-aware comparison counts in the significance figures. The expected values were produced by this implementation; the search and the counts are independently checked against brute-force oracles in test_dits.py, and dit-free input is checked identical to the pre-dit code.
